verdict.rationale: Teller publishes a headline coverage number, "more than 7,000 financial institutions," and documents a same-day ACH microdeposit fallback for unsupported banks. The evidence shows no published geography statement and no list of institutions a founder could check against where users bank. US scope can only be inferred from ACH and Zelle references; the UK bank lists on HN are old community posts that don't document current coverage. Missing for 10: explicit geographic coverage documentation, a searchable or published institution list, per-institution capability detail, and independent corroboration of the 7,000 figure.
